tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides game-theoretic importance scores that reveal how much each feature contributes to predictions, helping pinpoint high-attribution features. LIME and Integrated Gradients offer local interpretability, confirming whether shared features drive misclassification. Sensitivity analysis isolates causal impact by testing feature ablation, allowing us to verify if removing a feature changes predictions. Together, these tools validate the spuriousness and shared influence of features beyond semantic relevance.
